p: Coniah the son of Jehoiakim: Who was called Jehoiachin, or Jeconiah.
made king in the land of: And called him Zedekiah, while before his name was Mattaniah, 2Ki 24:17.
sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah: Because he was afraid of the Chaldeans who came against him.
in and went out among the: That is, was out of prison and free.
come from Egypt: To help the Jews.
land of Benjamin: As some think, to go to Anathoth his own town.
gate of Benjamin: By which men went into the country of Benjamin.
prison: Because it was a vile and straight prison.

bread in the city should be: That is, so long as there was any bread in the city: thus God provides for his, that he will cause their enemies to preserve them to that end to which he has appointed them.
